_what: The Quest Forge Angelica client: the jars that differ from the OptiFine E7 client. build_angelica_client.py applies this to a copy of an E7 game folder. sha1 is the authority; a jar with another hash is refused.
_decided: docs/design/angelica-decision.md (approved 2026-10-17). No Hodgepodge, no ArchaicFix: with them in, the client can only join a server that runs them too, and E7 clients cannot.

add.why: Angelica needs Forge 1614. Stock jar: the Quest Forge loading screen and splash music come from QuestForgeTweaks' SplashTransformer, not from a patched Forge jar.

_source_must_have: Jars the E7 folder must already carry. Since 2026-10-18 the whole pack (E7 clients and the server) runs GTNH CodeChickenCore 1.4.22, so the Angelica build no longer swaps it. An E7 folder from before that still has stock CodeChickenCore.jar + 1.7.10/CodeChickenLib: update it first (docs/setup/hosting-a-server.md, 'CodeChickenCore').

source_must_have.why: GTNH CodeChickenCore with CodeChickenLib merged in; stock CCC does not run under Angelica. Server and clients must all run it: its NEI packets differ from stock CCC's, and a mismatch kicks the client 5 s after login.

source_must_not_have.why: stock CodeChickenCore: does not run under Angelica, and the server no longer runs it
merged into GTNH CodeChickenCore 1.4.22; both at once is a duplicate mod

mods_add.why: The renderer: Celeritas chunk rendering + the Iris shader backport. Client only.
Mixin loader Angelica needs. The leading + keeps it first in load order.
Library Angelica needs. Client only here: never put it on the server (it becomes a required mod and locks out E7 clients).

pack_jars._what: Built from this repo. The same jars serve E7 and Angelica; these builds are the first that work under Angelica.
pack_jars.QuestForgeTweaks-1.0.jar: SplashTransformer (loading screen + splash music on stock Forge) and the Iris shader check in ShaderState.
pack_jars.QuestForgeContent-1.0.0.jar: The Iris shader check in Shaders (record case glass, jukebox chrome).
pack_jars.TransformersMod-0.6.3-qf1.jar: The Iris shader check in TFRenderHelper.

never_add.why: Changes the login and tile-entity packets: the client can then only join a server running Hodgepodge, and E7 clients cannot.
